name: ecommerce-customer-service-workspace-filament
description: The support agent's desk: the queue, the conversation, its transcript, the notes, the assembled timeline, the safe actions asked of other modules, and the service quality measured about all of it.
features: The queue is the domain's queue: rows from ListQueue, a place from QueuePosition, and a place is never stored
A conversation not in the queue renders as not queued, never as first and never as a count of nought
Assignment happens in one place, through AssignAgent, whether it is taken from the queue screen or from the record
A move the conversation cannot make from where it stands is not offered, and asking for one anyway is refused rather than done
Every write re-reads the conversation through FindConversation, so the guard runs against the row and not against the screen
Every mutation reports which of three things happened: recorded, already recorded, or refused and why
All nine refusal reasons the domain publishes have a sentence, and a tenth would fail the suite rather than an operator
A request to another module says the row was written even when the transmission was refused, so nobody asks twice
Every service figure is a subtraction the domain takes, and a figure it could not take renders as unmeasured rather than as zero
The conversations still open are excluded from every mean and counted out loud, so a good average is never a small sample
A conversation nobody ever reached is counted, because those are the ones a service metric most needs to see
The timeline is assembled at the moment of reading and names every source that could not be asked, with the reason for each
A source nobody bound is told apart from one that could not answer, because the two need different next steps
Nobody is asked about a participant who has been erased, because a redacted reference is the wrong person
The customer's email is on the record screen and on no listing, and the participant's claim is on neither
Viewing is answered by the domain's CustodyPolicy, and every other Filament ability is forced closed by name
Every page and widget states its own guard, because a screen with no policy is a screen where everything is allowed
One where clause in the whole package, and the suite fails if a second arrives
